edits.target: ## Cross-Shop Coverage for Complete and Tied Results
edits.content: For cheapest-offer, substitute, and end-to-end comparisons, also keep a per-shop ledger of matching candidates, prices, and exact URLs. Update the current best as you compare shops, and purchase only after the planned shop checks are complete.

## Verify Each Required Attribute
Qualify each distinct offer only when its own title, specifications, or description provide evidence for every required attribute. Do not infer a feature from a customizable display, a similar product, or another variant in the same product family; for example, an LCD alone does not establish GIF playback. If evidence is unclear, inspect that offer’s product details and keep it out of the final qualifying set unless the requirement is supported.

edits.target: ## Cross-Shop Coverage for Complete and Tied Results
edits.content: For cheapest-offer tasks, retain every distinct qualifying offer tied at the lowest price across all shops, including multiple matching products from the same shop. Capture and submit the exact URL for each tied offer.
